title: No regression coverage for onboarding slide state or permission watcher lifecycle
reasoning: This feature has nontrivial behavior around slide count clamping, empty permission manifests, external OS permission polling, focus/visibility rechecks, and timeout cleanup, but the feature metadata lists no tests and no included file provides assertions for these paths. Regressions here would affect first-run onboarding and OS permission grants, where manual reproduction is timing-dependent.
recommendation: Add focused Jest coverage for buildOnboardingSlideState and a hook/component test for permission grant polling cleanup, timeout behavior, and empty permission-manifest rendering.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature declares no linked tests, and the only context evidence is the package-level Jest commands, so this source group appears unprotected by feature-local regression tests.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover buildOnboardingSlideState with zero, one, and multiple permissions, plus useOnboardingPermissionActions with fake timers for needs-action polling, granted cleanup, timeout cleanup, and unmount cleanup.
minimumFixScope: Add feature-local Jest tests under the existing frontend test setup without changing runtime behavior.
